description.en: A growing collection of React components for building modern products. Arrives as source code you can read, edit, and make your own with your coding agent.
description.zh: 专为现代产品迭代打造的 React 组件集合：全部以清晰可读的源码交付，与 AI 编程助手高度协同，设计感浑然天成。

content.en: Stepwise UI provides a thoughtful collection of step-by-step product interaction patterns, wizard flows, and stateful widgets for React applications. Engineered to look genuinely designed rather than procedurally generated, each component arrives as clean, self-contained source code that you can freely adapt, customize, or let your AI coding agent extend. Highlights include progressive onboarding steppers, choice matrices, and contextual drawer flows.
content.zh: Stepwise UI 聚焦于打磨产品级流程与步骤引导交互。针对常见的注册向导、多步设置校验、复杂表单流转与上下文抽屉，它提供了设计质感精湛、拒绝流水线工业感的优雅模式。所有组件均以结构极其清晰的独立源码形式分发，不仅利于人类工程师直接按需微调，更针对 AI 编程 Agent 进行了友好注释，确保生成的产品界面具有出色的审美把控。
